global_style: A minimalist, Morandi-inspired presentation featuring a dusty pink palette, consistent dashed border framing, bold typography, and flat geometric layouts.

identity_anchors: Inset white dashed border framing the perimeter of most slides
Three-dot horizontal decorative motif in peach, teal, and coral
Flat, solid circular badges used for numbering, icons, and overlaps
High-contrast, stark white bold typography against muted backgrounds

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
